pool.text: The city received an annuity in perpetuity for the maintenance of needy people.
Cherbourg fell to the troops of Stephen of England after a long siege.
Cherbourg fell without a fight during the conquest of Normandy by Philip.
Philip IV of France fortified the city following previous ravages and attacks.
Francis I and the dauphin visited Cherbourg with great public fanfare.
Louis Lucas de Néhou built a famous glass factory producing window mirrors.
The Gare Maritime de Cherbourg opened on the Quai de France.
The Park of the Château des Ravalet was acquired by the city of Cherbourg.
American troops encircled the city during the Normandy invasion.
Cherbourg was officially returned to France by the American forces.
The city received the Croix de guerre with Palm citation.
Hortson was established in the Maupas quarter under leadership of Mayor Jacques Hébert.
The nuclear ballistic missile submarine Le Redoutable was launched.
The Communauté urbaine de Cherbourg gathered together several surrounding communes.
The urban community of Cherbourg was created following the urbanisation and boundary dilution.
The UIE began business in Cherbourg for the construction of oil platforms.
Activists protested the nuclearisation when the Pacific Fisher landed waste.
The Babcock boiler manufacturer closed its doors after a protracted labour dispute in Cherbourg.
The public transport company CTC took the new name Zephir Bus.
The Cherbourg-Normandy technopole was created for the control of contamination from industrial processes.
